question: Press reads, batch A: what each in-scope row of Pricing Plan, Product changes on the block.
how: Run f70 on the oracle: per block, Exit Without Saving, Edit on Blocks Probe, a blank section, Add Block and the block by name, Edit, then each step by a named press with an on-top check (a switch by its aria-label, a button by its label, a field by Cmd+A, Backspace and keys then Tab, a menu by its row then an option). The block (area, size, every visible leaf box) is read before and after each step. No row that makes something outside the block, opens a service, or reaches a store or payments was pressed. Left by Exit Without Saving; the page read 0 blocks at the end.

Pricing Plan.note: Design only (Content holds Get started, not pressed). Alignment left, right, center: rows stay 11. Each Elements switch off then on: Title off 9 rows, Description off 8, Price off 8, Benefits off 8, Button off 8; each back on returns to 11. Button Text typed Go: rows stay 11. Leaves before and after each step are in steps.
